name: 国风红金多色口红款
description: 国风红绿金三色体系，从红绸主图到多色阵列的唇部彩妆转化套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep brick-red silk drape #8E3B2E alternating with pine-green matte panels #1F3D2E and ivory matte board #F5EFE3, thin champagne-gold ring accents
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the upper left, gentle falloff, controlled speculars on the gold band, soft contact shadows
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte silk-textured backdrop with ivory matte board #F5EFE3 for infographic and scene shots
styleLock.typography: classic serif display family used consistently for headlines and labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin gold-line botanical sprigs and seal-frame tags in a single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: upright tube as the stable hero subject; consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent chinese national-style premium lipstick visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep brick-red silk #8E3B2E, pine-green matte #1F3D2E, champagne gold metal #D9B36C and ivory matte board #F5EFE3; warm soft studio lighting with an upper-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; classic serif display typography used consistently; thin gold-line botanical and seal-frame tag style; clean high-end beauty photography mixed with minimal national-style infographic elements; stable upright tube presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用国风红绿撞色建立高级第一印象
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, camera tilted very slightly upward, tube upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: warm soft studio key from the upper left, gentle falloff, controlled speculars on the gold band, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep brick-red silk drape #8E3B2E with a pine-green round medallion #1F3D2E edged by a thin champagne-gold ring #D9B36C
shots.props: magnolia sprig and red berries entering from the right edge; the cap resting diagonally in front
shots.whitespace: none; the medallion frames the tube tightly
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One closed lipstick tube standing upright with its cap resting diagonally in front, photographed straight-on at eye-level with the camera tilted very slightly upward for a subtle heroic stance, full product visible. Warm soft studio key from the upper left, gentle falloff, controlled specular highlights on the gold band, a soft contact shadow grounding the tube. Deep brick-red silk drape background #8E3B2E with a large pine-green round medallion #1F3D2E edged by a thin champagne-gold ring #D9B36C, a magnolia sprig and a few red berries entering from the right edge. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace; the medallion frames the tube tightly. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no added brand lettering or store badges, no watermark, no QR code, no membership badge, no model face or lips, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating product without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 承接主图，一秒传达核心质地卖点并留出文案区
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, tube upright on the left third
shots.lighting: warm soft key from the upper left, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper 30% reserved for the headline copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing upright on the left third at a slight 3/4 angle, warm soft key from the upper left with a soft contact shadow. Deep pine-green matte background #1F3D2E. In the upper 30% of the frame a headline reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with two short sub-lines 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 set in ivory #F5EFE3, aligned above the product. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame. Generous negative space across the upper 30% reserved for the headline copy. Negative: no duration or waterproof performance numbers rendered as facts, no extra text beyond the placeholders, no garbled characters, no model face, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大沾杯、掉妆类日常尴尬痛点，用空白卡位承接具体场景文案
shots.camera: straight-on flat infographic layout, product small on the left
shots.lighting: warm even flat lighting, soft contact shadow
shots.props: three empty rounded placeholder cards in pine-green fill #1F3D2E with thin champagne-gold outlines #D9B36C
shots.whitespace: moderate negative space between the cards and around the headline band for breathing room
shots.textZone: upper headline band plus a row of short labels beneath the three cards in the lower third
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat infographic layout with the tube standing small on the left, angled slightly toward the camera, and across the lower third a row of three empty rounded cards in pine-green fill #1F3D2E with thin champagne-gold outlines #D9B36C, each card left blank with a short label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 beneath in ivory #F5EFE3. In the upper band a headline reading 「{selling_point_4}」. Warm even flat lighting with a soft contact shadow. Deep brick-red matte background #8E3B2E. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Moderate negative space between the cards and around the headline band for breathing room. Negative: no model face or recognizable person, no fabricated statistics or test data, no filled-in claim text inside the cards, no extra text beyond the placeholders, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入真实补涂场景，让买家投射到自己的梳妆时刻
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow
shots.props: folded silk ribbon and a small round mirror, not covering the product; a hand entering from the frame edge only
shots.whitespace: modest negative space in the upper quarter for optional copy overlay
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube standing on an ivory matte vanity board #F5EFE3 beside a folded silk ribbon and a small round mirror, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel; only a hand entering from the frame edge reaching toward the tube, no face in frame. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadow. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Modest negative space in the upper quarter for optional copy overlay. Negative: no visible face or recognizable person, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered dressing table, no duplicated background objects.

shots.intent: 用膏体斜面切割与质地微距证明做工与质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing the bullet surface, controlled highlight on the gold band
shots.whitespace: minimal; the bullet surface is the whole subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the slanted bullet tip showing its sculpted cut surface and fine matte texture. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp; skimming side light from the right revealing the bullet surface, a controlled highlight on the gold band. Deep brick-red matte background #8E3B2E. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal whitespace; the bullet surface is the whole subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no melted or chipped texture, no fingers or lips, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 平铺展示多色可选，让买家在色阶中完成选择
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, identical across all cards
shots.props: rounded shade cards with brick-red fill #8E3B2E and thin gold outlines, small blank nameplates beneath each card
shots.whitespace: even margins around the grid as breathing space
shots.textZone: top headline zone plus blank nameplates beneath each card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Four shade variants arranged in a two-by-two flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, each bullet inside a rounded card on brick-red fill #8E3B2E with a thin gold outline, the shade chips stepping through matte deep brick red #8E3B2E, semi-matte strawberry red #C4526A, mist tomato red #D2402E and mist retro crimson #A62639, identical lighting across all four cards. Deep pine-green matte backdrop #1F3D2E with a headline reading 「{selling_point_5}」 across the top in ivory #F5EFE3. The variants occupy 70-80% of the frame overall. Even margins around the grid as breathing space. Negative: no lighting drift between variants, no readable shade codes or numbers, no extra text beyond the placeholder, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicated card edges.

shots.intent: 用结构化参数表消除规格疑虑，空值位留待真实资料填充
shots.camera: straight-on flat layout, product upright at slight 3/4 on the left
shots.lighting: warm even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: two-column spec table with deep-red label rows #8E3B2E and champagne-gold text #D9B36C, all value cells left as empty gold-outlined blanks
shots.whitespace: even margins around the table for readable spacing
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat layout: the tube upright on the left at a slight 3/4 angle, and on the right a two-column table of deep-red label rows in #8E3B2E with champagne-gold text #D9B36C, one row carrying the label 「{callout_4}」 while every value cell is left as an empty gold-outlined blank cell. Warm even flat lighting, no dramatic shadow. Ivory matte board background #F5EFE3. The product occupies 45-50% of the frame. Even margins around the table for readable spacing. Negative: no filled-in spec values, no fabricated numbers, units or certifications, no tiny unreadable text, no test-report badges, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以礼盒组合与空 CTA 位收口促单
shots.camera: group shot at slight 3/4, one tube upright and one lying in front
shots.lighting: warm soft studio light, soft contact shadows
shots.props: champagne-gold ribbon arc #D9B36C behind the set and an empty gold-outlined CTA button shape at the bottom center
shots.whitespace: clear negative space around the button zone and above the set for the closing copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A gift-set composition with one tube upright and a second identical tube lying at a slight 3/4 angle in front, a champagne-gold ribbon arc #D9B36C sweeping behind them, warm soft studio light with soft contact shadows. Deep pine-green matte background #1F3D2E. At the bottom center an empty gold-outlined CTA button reserved for 「{callout_5}」. The set occupies 55-60% of the frame overall. Clear negative space around the button zone and above the set for the closing copy. Negative: no invented discount numbers or countdowns, no membership or QR badges, no extra text beyond the placeholder, no watermark, no fake logo, no model.

provenance.notes: 8 屏逐屏：1 红绸底绿色圆章国风主图（立管+斜放盖+玉兰花与红果）；2 膏体斜置特写加绿色文案带与模特面容屏；3 模特半身痛点提问屏与三张空红卡；4 三卡场景标注（喝水沾杯/零食脱妆/接吻掉妆）加红底卖点屏；5 膏体特写与多色可选文案；6 四色号阵列（哑光猪肝红/半哑草莓红/雾面番茄红/雾面复古红）与植物提取文案；7 草丛装饰图与口红参数空表格；8 参数表尾行与会员二维码角标。品类判定：参数区标题直书口红、色号体系为哑光/半哑/雾面红色系、通篇为唇部上妆用途，故按图判为美妆彩妆/唇部，而非源夹名所示洗护。已剥离：模特面容与唇部身份特征、原品牌字样与水印、会员二维码角标、原文案原句、防水锁色与持久时长等功效断言（一律改占位）、参数表具体数值（留空占位）、具体色号编号（仅保留色系结构描述）；试色一律改为膏体特写与抽象色块，不出现可辨识唇部特写。
